notes: The italicized *even* introduces an articular appositive (ὁ ἁγιασμὸς ὑμῶν), which rule 105 puts on the `added` side: no expressed preposition carries it, and rule 20 has already emptied the governing article. Folding it onto ἁγιασμός remains defensible and the unit says so.
s005 and s013 are left unrepresented under rule 21's determinerless clause, the case prepositions staying with θεοῦ and πορνείας.
s010 ἀπέχεσθαι takes the supplied complementizer under rule 85, discontinuously around the expressed subject ὑμᾶς.
